title: 10 December 1964: Ringo Starr leaves hospital
content:
Ringo Starr’s 10-day stay at London’s University College Hospital came to an end on this day.

He had gone in to have his tonsils removed on 2 December 1964, and his stay in the ward attracted much attention from reporters and fans.
